categories_thin: Orthodontists and oral surgeons: no independent orthodontic practice with a Cranbury street address was found; searches returned South Brunswick and Kendall Park practices that only list Cranbury as a service area. One directory lists 'Princeton Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery PC' at 339 Princeton-Hightstown Rd, Cranbury, but the practice's own site shows a Princeton Junction office, so it was not added.

Accounting and tax: many solo CPAs are listed only at house-style addresses (Pinehurst Dr, Knight Ct, Millstone Dr, Washington Dr, Dey Rd); those beyond the ones already listed were left out to avoid publishing home addresses, so the real count of practices is probably higher than the list shows.

Retail (non-food): the village core has a handful of boutiques, a florist, a gift shop and a bike shop; no hardware, furniture, appliance or jewelry store inside the township (the Route 130 home-improvement stores are chains and excluded).

Tutoring, dance and art schools: no Cranbury-based provider confirmed. A directory lists Shivaay Dance Academy at 1261 S River Rd, Cranbury, but the academy's own location page lists Monroe, Skillman, Sewell and Moorestown and no Cranbury, so it was not added. Tutoring that mentions Cranbury is either in-home (Club Z Monroe) or based in Princeton Junction/East Brunswick.
Medical doctors: physicians at Cranbury addresses mostly belong to large health systems and were excluded, so the independent-practice count is low (one pediatric practice).

Roofing, siding, windows, flooring, painting, cleaning, restoration and pest control: every company ranking for 'Cranbury' that was checked (Emmons, Power Construction, Matute, Cowleys, Viking, Excel) advertises Cranbury only as a service area from a base in another town; no Cranbury-based firm in these trades surfaced.

Automotive bodywork and tires: only two general repair shops (George's Garage, Cranbury Service Center) plus the high-end specialist; no independent body shop or tire dealer with a Cranbury address was found.
caveats: Cranbury Township sits at the 10-mile edge of the Milltown radius. The village core (about 40.316, -74.514) is roughly 9.9 miles from Milltown centre, but the southern Route 130 / Haypress Rd / Half Acre Rd industrial belt and Cranbury Station Rd addresses are at or just beyond 10 miles - analysts should check coordinates per address before outreach.

ONE RULE ON MULTI-LOCATION OPERATIONS (revised): a business is excluded only if it is a brand franchise or chain storefront, a government office, public school, university, hospital or large health system, a bank/credit union, a place of worship, or obviously over 500 staff at that site. Multi-office independent firms, branch offices and US offices of foreign-parent manufacturers are therefore all RETAINED (Playmobil, Hioki, Daler Rowney, Plymovent, Robotunits, Demarle, Main Tape, Hanwha, Eastern Bag & Paper, Taylor Wiseman & Taylor, Prager Metis, Pine Environmental, Knapp's Cyclery, Leaders In Learning Academy). They are flagged in their notes so triage can weigh branch-office status; they are not treated as single-site local independents.

The same rule applied to the earlier exclusions of L'Oreal USA, Taro, Biocon, CMIC, Stada, Kronos etc.: those were dropped for size at the site (each is a large plant or corporate site, over the 500-staff line), not merely for being multi-location. Where headcount at a Cranbury site could not be established (CRP Industries, Port Jersey Logistics, Hanwha), the entry is kept and the uncertainty is noted.

The 08512 ZIP spills into East Windsor, Plainsboro, Monroe and South Brunswick. Entries here carry a Cranbury / Cranbury Township address in their source, but some 'Cranbury, NJ 08512' businesses are physically in East Windsor or Monroe (e.g. 379 Princeton-Hightstown Rd, 294 Applegarth Rd, 300 Princeton-Hightstown Rd) and were excluded.

Franchise/brand locations excluded even where locally operated: Jazzercise Cranbury (deleted in this revision), T&T Coast GMC (car dealer), Minuteman Press Cranbury, Roto-Rooter, SERVPRO of Old Bridge/Cranbury, Extra Space Storage, Home Depot, State Farm (Shilpa Rathi), Allstate (Sangeeta Malik), RE/MAX Select, Callaway Henderson Sotheby's, Staybridge Suites / Hampton Inn / TownePlace Suites.

Excluded as large institutions, health systems or government: Penn Princeton Primary Care Cranbury, L'Oreal USA, Taro Pharmaceuticals, Biocon Generics, CMIC CMO, Palatin Technologies, Stada, Kronos, Mercury Marine, Associated Press, SanMar, Anixter, Crate & Barrel distribution, Prologis Park, First Constitution Bank, Cranbury Township Public Works, Trans-Atlantic Renal Council.

Childcare and preschools (Montessori Preschool Academy, HoneyBee Montessori, Leaders In Learning Academy, Cranbury Presbyterian Nursery School) are KEPT on one consistent rule: group D of the brief explicitly includes childcare and preschools, and the 'schools' exclusion covers public schools and universities. All four are handled the same way; none is a special exception.

Several accounting, salon and manufacturing entries come from bulk directories (njbusinessdirectory.org, MerchantCircle, njtgo.com, njnewjerseytax.com) that may carry stale records; active_evidence says 'one directory only' where that is the case.
A second 'Cranbury Dental Clinic' site (cranburydentalcare.com, phone 732-390-9093) was found but shows no address, so it was left out rather than guessed into the zone.
data_gaps: OpenStreetMap / Overpass API was unreachable from this environment (two endpoints timed out or aborted), so no OSM-based sweep was possible.

Yellow Pages, BBB, Cylex, AllPages, Opendi, Hubbiz, Superpages and MapQuest all returned HTTP 403 (bot protection) to direct fetches; their content was used only through search-result snippets and category URLs, so per-business addresses could not be verified there.
Google Maps in the browser returned a 'limited view' of only about five results per category, so it was used to confirm individual listings rather than to enumerate the zone.

CORRECTED: Cranbury does have an active business association - the Cranbury Business Association at cbacranbury.com (site opened; shows 2026 events, member benefits and categories such as 'Shopping - Dining - Health & Wellness - Home Services - Professional Services - Arts & Culture'). A search of the former Chamber route (merged into the Central NJ Chamber) found no Cranbury-filtered public member roster.

Head to Tails Grooming and Doggy Daycare was REMOVED: its own contact page gives 625 Mercer Street, Hightstown, NJ with phone 609-490-0014, and Hightstown is roughly 15 straight-line miles from Milltown centre - outside the 10-mile zone. The Cranbury address it previously carried was the Love Your Dog Daycare address (a directory conflation).
